core.title: Lido Door Lever Set, Kwikset LL

text.description_html:
Kwikset LL, Classic Lido Scroll Leverset

Kwikset's Lido Lever is a proven best seller. The exquisitely elegant scroll design makes a stylish design statement. With an adjustable backset for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" for doors 1-3/8" up to 1-3/4" thick, it fits standard pre-drilled doors. Available in dummy, passage, privacy, and keyed entry functions.

Features of the Classic Kwikset Lido Door Lever Set:

  • Fits most pre-drilled doors.
  • Anti-pick SmartKey system (on Keyed Entry function).
  • Non-handed levers (except half dummy function).
  • Sold as complete set.
  • Easy to install.
  • Manufacture Lifetime Mechanical & Finish Warranty.

Specifications of the LL Lido Lever:

  • Rose Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Lever Length: 3-3/4"
  • Lever Projection: 1-29/32"
  • Keyed Entry Lever Projection: 2-15/32"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/8" up to 1-3/4"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"

When Selecting a Function:

  • Half Dummy: An inactive lever for use as a pull or to match trim. This non-operational lever is for one side of the door. Complete Set - 1 lever and 1 rose.
  • Passage (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latch operates from either side of door. Complete set - 2 levers, 2 roses, door latch and strike plate.
  • Privacy (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need locking. Latch operates from either side. Turnbutton on interior lever engages privacy lock on both levers; emergency release hole is on exterior lever. Complete set - 2 levers, 2 roses, privacy button, door latch and strike plate.
  • Keyed Entry: Use when a keyed lock is needed. An ANSI/BHMA A156.2 Grade 2 security lock that is operated by a key from the exterior and a turnbutton on the lever from the interior. Complete set - 2 levers, 2 roses, 2 keys, door latch and strike plate.

The Half Dummy Levers are Handed. Click Here to Determine Handing. All other Lido Lever functions are non-handed.



***This is a Discontinued item and is no longer available.
